stem: Rainfall totals are high, but root-zone measurements show only shallow wetting and deep soil remains dry. What is the strongest management conclusion?
choices: Rainfall total alone does not describe effective root-zone recharge; infiltration depth and crop demand still matter
Irrigation should stop for the month
Rain always wets the full root zone
rationale: Effective rainfall depends on intensity, infiltration, runoff and rooting depth, not total precipitation alone.
